scope: VOKU On shared screen polish: controls, dialogs, loading/error/empty feedback. Existing layout retained; separate operator dashboard excluded.
changes: One shared dialog for archive and community with a 44px close button and visual viewport height limit
Header icon buttons, small buttons, search clearing, and select options have larger touch targets
Post/comment menus align to the right edge of their trigger and stay within the viewport
Scrollable dialog body replaces nested scrolling in cue-sheet attachment search; long action labels wrap
Shared Korean loading, retry, and empty-state feedback; home lazy-load failures have recovery actions
Empty board searches and linked-only lists offer a way to clear the condition; empty categories offer writing

automated.archiveIntegrity: 5330 documents, 66010 pages, 71 cached source hashes, 32 year previews

browser.reportDialog: Select options stay in bounds, Tab remains in dialog, Escape returns to post menu trigger; no report submitted
browser.emptySearch: Search reset restores the board results and clears query
limitations: Physical iOS/Android keyboards were not used; keyboard-visible height was simulated in the actual dialog component.
